What makes The Clear Quran fit for this unprecedented project is its ability to reflect some of the beauty of the original in the English language. It’s noted for clarity, accuracy, eloquence, and flow, and has been officially approved by Al-Azhar, and endorsed by the Canadian Council of Imams, as well as many qualified scholars from all over the world.
